daangnRules: Text only: images and videos are not carried over; tables become one line per row.

No partner link of any network (링크프라이스, 토스쇼핑 쉐어링크, 커넥트, 쿠팡파트너스, 마이리얼트립) and no network disclosure on 당근, and only informational posts are mirrored: a run whose gate plan declares affiliate links, and the shopping (핫딜 공유) route, are skipped (owner 2026-10-01: "앞으로 당근에는 파트너 링크 나가야하는거 아예주지말고, 정보성 도메인만 미러링해라"; supersedes the 2026-09-27 LinkPrice A100708123 rule). Links in a mirrored post are official seller or notice URLs only.
No link back to the Naver blog (당근 모임 정책: 외부 앱 유도·홍보 제한).
One journaled create per article; an uncertain write is reconciled against the full feed, never retried.
naverCafeRules: Boards are dynamic (owner 2026-09-27): each route names its board in naverCafeMenu; a Naver category without a route uses its category name. The board is found by name in the live menu list and created once when missing (journaled board-add, ledger in affiliate-api-hub/runtime/naver-cafe-board-adds.json). No board IDs are stored.
naverCafeDefaults.open true = 전체공개 (owner 2026-09-27); a route may override with naverCafeOpen. naverCafeSkip keeps that kind of post off the cafe.
Text only until a cafe photo upload is observed: the post opens and ends with the Naver blog URL, which carries the images and videos.
링크프라이스 links keep their link with the cafe site id A100708124 and the disclosure (owner 2026-09-27); 커넥트 and other networks go to the declared seller page and their disclosure is dropped.
One journaled create per article through apps/naver-cafe-api manage.mjs post-create; an uncertain write is reconciled against the full list, never retried.
snsRules: owner 2026-09-27: 한 번 쓰면 X·스레드·인스타·틱톡·유튜브까지 퍼진다. 브랜드 계정 생활이득AI연구소, 웹 세션 XHR, 영상은 자동 생성 + AI 내레이션.
mirror-sns.mjs builds <run>/sns/ (versions.json, instagram cards, shorts.mp4) from the verified Naver revision; a channel publishes only when its status is ready (brand session stored in DPAPI).

SNS posts made from a blog article (sns-publish) link to the blog; the only affiliate link they carry is the 토스 쉐어링크 reply after the chain, with its disclosure; when the article has affiliate links the link post says 제휴 링크 포함 글. Quick-fact posts (X, Threads, Telegram; domains A/E) may carry affiliate links only for networks registered for that channel in affiliate-networks.v1.json, with the registered disclosure in the main body (owner 2026-09-30, 2026-10-04; policy history in that file). 당근 never takes a partner link from quick-fact.
Feed channels open with curiosity/question hooks, not price/deadline (hook-ontology channelPreferences).
